description: This file defines classes and functions related to managing module commands in a Linux distribution's kickstart configuration, including data classes for different RHEL versions and command parsing logic.

classes.name: F29_ModuleData
classes.description: Data class representing a module with name and stream, for Fedora 29.

classes.name: RHEL8_ModuleData
classes.description: Extended module data class with enable/disable flag, for RHEL 8.

classes.name: F31_ModuleData
classes.description: Module data class for Fedora 31, inherits from RHEL8_ModuleData.

classes.name: F29_Module
classes.description: Command class to handle module commands, including parsing and string representation.

classes.name: RHEL8_Module
classes.description: RHEL 8 specific module command with disable option.

classes.name: F31_Module
classes.description: Fedora 31 specific module command, inherits from RHEL8_Module.

classes.name: F41_Module
classes.description: Deprecated module command class, inherits from F31_Module, with deprecation notice.

classes.name: RHEL10_Module
classes.description: RHEL 10 specific module command, inherits from F41_Module.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes data classes and command classes with version-specific attributes.

methods.name: _getArgsAsStr
methods.description: Returns string representation of module arguments, including optional stream and enable/disable flags.

methods.name: _getParser
methods.description: Creates and configures argument parser for the module command.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses command line arguments to create a module command data object.

methods.name: dataList
methods.description: Returns the list of module data objects.

methods.name: set_to_obj
methods.description: Sets parsed arguments into a data object (assumed method).
